all_cols = set()
for f in ["BaoCaoTonKho.xlsx","DanhSachSanPham.xlsx","DanhSachNhapHang.xlsx",
          "DanhSachChiTietNhapHang.xlsx","DanhSachHoaDon.xlsx",
          "DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet_1.xlsx","DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet_2.xlsx",
          "DanhSachKhachHang.xlsx","SoQuy.xlsx","DanhSachDonViTinh.xlsx"]:
    df = pd.read_excel(f)
    for c in df.columns:
        all_cols.add(c.lower())
print(sorted(all_cols))
# Check inventory file content fully for any date/expiration hints
inv = pd.read_excel("BaoCaoTonKho.xlsx")
print("\nInventory columns:", list(inv.columns))
print("Sample:", inv.head(3).to_string())
print("Any 'hạn'/'expiration' in any column name? ", any('hạn' in c or 'expir' in c or 'date' in c for c in inv.columns))
